A '''nest-guild''' was a social grouping among the [[Feline/Legends|felinoid]] [[Schenor]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Each nest-guild was led by a [[nest-guildmaster]], and included [[nest-warrior]]s.<ref name="Silent Witness" />
